request: AWK-style tokenization must treat line breaks as whitespace alongside spaces and tabs, omitting leading whitespace from the first token while retaining its trailing whitespace and recording its starting offset. With an explicit delimiter, tokens must retain the delimiter and leading whitespace, and whitespace-delimited token offsets must reflect their positions in the original input.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: Fix AWK tokenizer not treating a new line character as whitespace

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > src/tokenizer_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestTokenize)$' ./src >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
